notes.b4d4a134359bf1d2: False positive — backend/service/memory.py:686. semgrep avoid-sqlalchemy-text on the full-text WHERE clause. What is concatenated is _FTS_SQL (line 439), a module-level literal. sa.text() is required because Postgres only uses the functional GIN index when the tsvector expression appears inline. maintenance: Only CRITICAL findings block CI, so only verified-false-positive criticals belong here. Add entries by hand with a note rather than running --write-baseline, which overwrites this file with every current finding and would silently suppress real HIGH/MEDIUM issues. A fingerprint is sha256(severity|title|detail), and detail carries the file AND line — so an entry suppresses one line, not a file. Moving the code re-raises the finding, which is the intended behaviour: the note above it has to be re-earned.
